items.title: Spot Gas National Average Slips as Eastern Losses Outweigh Western Heat
items.summary: Physical natural gas prices edged lower Wednesday for Thursday flow as rainfall and moderating temperatures pressured markets across the Northeast and Appalachia.

items.title: Corpus Christi Train 7 Feedgas Approval Advances Final Ramp-Up
items.summary: Corpus Christi LNG has received federal authorization to introduce feedgas to the warm end of Midscale Train 7, advancing commissioning of the final unit in Cheniere Energy’s Stage 3 expansion.

items.title: Expand Energy Builds Natural Gas Marketing, Haynesville Scale for LNG, Power Growth
items.summary: Houston’s Expand Energy, the largest natural gas producer in the United States, boosted its footprint in the Haynesville Shale to position itself to meet the fast-growing Gulf Coast power, industrial and LNG export markets.

items.title: Buyers Find Bargains, yet Natural Gas Futures Only Inch Ahead
items.summary: Traders examined evolving weather forecasts and supply strength as the August New York Mercantile Exchange natural gas futures contract tiptoed into positive territory at midday on Wednesday, its last session before rolling off the board.

items.title: Permian Pipeline Additions, Demand Drive Waha Natural Gas Price About-Face
items.summary: After spending nearly six months mired in negative territory, Waha natural gas cash prices staged a sharp turnaround this summer as new pipeline capacity began relieving chronic egress constraints in the Permian Basin.

items.title: OFS Executives Report Resurgent Natural Gas, Oil Activity in North America
items.summary: Management teams of the major oilfield services (OFS) providers are unanimously reporting increased activity and improved sentiment from their North American exploration and production (E&P) customers.

items.title: Prince Rupert Pipeline Contract Advances Ksi Lisims LNG Feedgas Link
items.summary: Two partners behind Ksi Lisims LNG have advanced the project’s planned feedgas connection to the Western Canadian Sedimentary Basin, awarding Allseas a contract for a critical section of the Prince Rupert Gas Transmission (PRGT) pipeline.

items.title: Natural Gas Power Burn Slips from One-Year High as Wind Roars Back
items.summary: Natural gas-fired power generation slipped from a nearly one-year high during the latest US Energy Information Administration (EIA) storage week as wind and solar output increased, though spot prices edged higher amid regional summer heat.
